address: InterContinental Lyon - Hotel Dieu, 20 quai Jules-Courmont, Lyon, 69002, France
bio: A hospital for eight centuries, the former Hôtel-Dieu has preserved all the building's historical character. The Epona restaurant serves regional specialities with a modern twist, which you can enjoy in a lovely setting that calls to mind a high-end brasserie. And in fine weather, the team welcomes you in a superb courtyard garden....
